PEN VAR GOAL OFF SIDE
CORNER SUB YELLOW RED
OWN GOAL FREE SPACE KICK OUTSIDE

Rachel Li: This is perfect. I'll print 12 copies and bring a Sharpie. Also putting a tiny $10 bar tab for the winner. :thumbsup:

Luca Martinez: I'll do scorekeeper if I'm there. If not, Rachel can ban me from the next one :grin:

Samir Khan: lol yes. See you all Saturday.
